name: Roberta Schwartz
moniker: Hospital Innovation Chief Bringing AI to the Bedside
quick_facts: EVP and Chief Innovation Officer at Houston Methodist Hospital
Leads Houston Methodist's Center for Innovation, piloting AI tools in clinical settings
Oversees deployment of ambient AI documentation and clinical decision-support tools
Regular public speaker and writer on responsible AI adoption in hospital systems
hook: Schwartz runs the innovation function at one of the country's leading academic hospital systems, where her job is turning AI tools, from ambient clinical documentation to decision support, from vendor pitches into things doctors and nurses actually trust and use at the bedside.

achievements.title: Building Houston Methodist's Center for Innovation
achievements.impact: Established a dedicated function for piloting and validating new clinical technologies, including AI tools, before hospital-wide deployment.

achievements.title: Leading rollout of ambient AI clinical documentation tools
achievements.impact: Deployed AI scribe technology to reduce physician administrative burden and documentation time across Houston Methodist's clinical staff.

achievements.title: Piloting AI-driven clinical decision support systems
achievements.impact: Directed evaluation and controlled deployment of AI tools intended to support, not replace, physician clinical judgment.

achievements.title: Public advocacy for responsible AI adoption in healthcare
achievements.impact: Frequent conference speaker and author on balancing AI innovation with patient safety and clinician trust in hospital settings.

timeline.event: Joins Houston Methodist in hospital operations and innovation leadership
timeline.impact: Builds institutional foundation for innovation function

timeline.event: Leads deployment of AI ambient documentation tools

timeline.impact: Establishes a validation pathway for AI tools before hospital-wide use

quote.text: AI in healthcare only works if clinicians trust it, and trust is earned by proving the technology makes their job easier and their patients safer, not by mandate.
quote.context: A recurring theme in Schwartz's public remarks on clinical AI adoption at Houston Methodist
